caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden table set against a plain, light beige background. The table has a rectangular top with ornate, wavy edges and a visible wood grain texture rendered in shades of brown and golden yellow. The sides of the table top and the apron below it are similarly colored with brown tones and detailed wood patterns. The table is supported by four cabriole legs, each with a pronounced outward and inward curve, matching the style of the tabletop edges. Shadows cast by the legs fall softly on the surface below, indicating a light source from the upper left. No other objects or decorations are present in the composition.
title: Footstool
